name: YMCA Camp Foss
description_short: A YMCA overnight summer camp for girls ages 8 to 15, with 7-year-olds welcome in the fourth session. Stays run one week, two weeks, one month or the full summer, from June 27 to August 21, 2027, with Sunday check-in and Saturday check-out. Older teens can apply to the Counselor in Training program.
refund_policy_summary: To cancel for a non-medical reason, you must tell the Enrollment Coordinator at least four weeks before the session starts. Deposits paid at registration are non-refundable. Medical cancellations need a doctor's note. The final payment is due May 15, 2027. Discounts: 10% off for Granite YMCA members, 10% off per new friend referred, and 5% off per sibling.

Intersession Days are an optional $200 add-on (July 10-11, July 24-25, August 7-8, 2027). They are included in the One Month and Full Summer stays and are not recorded as sessions.
The price range ($1,650 to $10,450) covers camper sessions only. The CIT program costs $500 per session.
The page lists discounts for Granite YMCA members (10%), friend referrals (10%) and siblings (5%). The prices shown are before discounts.
